title: Reports Emerge on Boeing 737 Security Vulnerabilities
description: Recent reports highlight potential security risks involving the Boeing 737, focusing on small devices and flight computers.

sources.title: This Coin-Sized Device Can Hack a Boeing 737

sections.heading: Device Capabilities
paragraphs: According to WIRED, a coin-sized device can hack a Boeing 737. Additionally, StudyFinds reports that a small hidden chip could let someone manipulate the Boeing 737's flight computer.

sections.heading: Research Findings
paragraphs: Hackaday reports that researchers have hacked an airline analog.
